title: A partial derivative is a slope of a slice
caption: Hold y = 2 and f becomes the curve 2x² + 12x. At x = 1 it passes through (1, 14) with slope f_x(1, 2) = 2xy + 3y² = 16: the partial derivative is an ordinary gradient along the slice. (f_y(1, 2) = 13 is the same idea along y.)
alt: The curve z = 2x² + 12x rising steeply, with its tangent line of slope 16 touching it at the point (1, 14).
description: Fix y = 2: f(x, 2) = 2x² + 12x is a curve in one variable.
At x = 1 its height is f(1, 2) = 14.
Its slope there is 4x + 12 = 16, which equals f_x(1, 2).
The tangent line z = 14 + 16(x − 1) touches the curve at that point.
